resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified 25 remaining Bokmål residues and mixed-language technical explanations across Ohm's law, Joule heating, Kirchhoff terminology, heat flux, SI conversions, and wire gauges; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The section title used the Bokmål forms Omformede formler.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Omformede formler’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk title ‘Omforma formlar’.

findings.summary: The instruction used the Bokmål verb setter.
evidence: The previous instruction said ‘Bruk versjonen som setter verdien du vil finne på venstre side:’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as natural Nynorsk: ‘Bruk den forma som set verdien du vil finne, på venstresida:’.

findings.summary: The power explanation mixed a less natural formulation with the Nynorsk surrounding text.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘samanhengen for effekt’ and mixed phrasing around the component's thermal reserve.
findings.resolution: Recast the paragraph with the clearer Nynorsk term ‘effektformelen’ and consistent technical wording.

findings.summary: The description omitted the Nynorsk article before motstand.
evidence: The previous description ended ‘når straum går gjennom motstand’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘når straum går gjennom ein motstand’.

findings.summary: The example title used the Bokmål form Regneeksempel.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Regneeksempel’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Rekneeksempel’.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph retained multiple Bokmål forms including komponenter, tilkoblinger, forventet, and virkelige.
evidence: The previous paragraph mixed Bokmål and Nynorsk in its component, margin, and battery wording.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with consistent Nynorsk safety terminology.

findings.summary: The compound Krinstermar was less natural than a plain Nynorsk description of the section.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Krinstermar’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer title ‘Omgrep i krinsar’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example title used the Bokmål forms Gjennomsnittlig and varmeovn.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Gjennomsnittlig varmestrømstetthet fra en varmeovn’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Gjennomsnittleg varmestrømtettleik frå ein varmeomn’.

findings.summary: The conduction title used the Bokmål form Ledning.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Ledning gjennom et flatt lag’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Leiing gjennom eit flatt lag’.

findings.summary: The convection explanation mixed Bokmål verbs, nouns, and the phrase strålingsligningen.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘bruker’, ‘temperaturene’, and ‘strålingsligningen’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘brukar’, ‘temperaturane’, and ‘strålingslikninga’.

findings.summary: The area-conversion instruction used the Bokmål forms Konverter and bruker.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Konverter arealet til m² før du bruker W/m²’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Gjer arealet om til m² før du brukar W/m²’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux distinction ended with the Bokmål article en.
evidence: The previous bullet ended ‘ikkje en temperatur’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to consistent Nynorsk and clarified the purpose of varmekapasitet.

findings.summary: The conversion paragraph mixed Bokmål til slutt forms such as For eksempel, Konverter, and bruker.
evidence: The previous paragraph said ‘For eksempel ... Konverter verdier ... før du bruker en formel’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the consistent Nynorsk wording ‘Til dømes’, ‘Gjer om’, and ‘brukar’.

findings.summary: The area-and-volume conversion conclusion used the Bokmål compound omregning and bruker.
evidence: The previous conclusion said ‘Areal- og volumomregning bruker lengdefaktoren ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Areal- og volumsomrekning brukar lengdefaktoren ...’.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge description used the Bokmål compound systemer.
evidence: The previous description began ‘Tråddimensjonssystemer beskriver ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk compound ‘Tråddimensjonssystem’.

findings.summary: The gauge-section title retained a Bokmål plural form.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Dimensjonssystemer’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Dimensjonssystem’.

findings.summary: The gauge-number bullet mixed Et, vanlig, størrelser, and bruker with Nynorsk wording.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘Et høgare vanlig dimensjonstall’ and ended ‘størrelser ... bruker’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘Eit’, ‘vanleg’, ‘storleikar’, and ‘brukar’.

findings.summary: The gauge-system paragraph mixed beregnes, det samme, and systemene.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘skal ikkje beregnes’, ‘Det samme tallet’, and ‘systemene’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘reknast ut’, ‘Det same talet’, and ‘systema’.

findings.summary: The AWG paragraph retained Bokmål bruker, lederstørrelsen, avhenger, and gjeldende regler.
evidence: The previous paragraph mixed Bokmål forms throughout the AWG safety qualification.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘brukar’, ‘leidarstorleiken’, ‘kjem an på’, and ‘gjeldande elektriske reglar’.

findings.summary: The system-comparison title used the Bokmål form Hvorfor.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Hvorfor systemnavnet er viktig’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kvifor systemnamnet er viktig’.

findings.summary: The resistance explanation mixed avhenger, en, gi, betydelig, same, and dobler.
evidence: The previous paragraph contained several Bokmål forms in the diameter and resistance explanation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent Nynorsk vocabulary and preserved the AWG relationship.

findings.summary: The specification instruction used Oppgi and for eksempel.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Oppgi systemet, for eksempel ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Oppgje systemet, til dømes ...’.

findings.summary: The diameter-specification bullet used the Bokmål plural systemene and kan forveksles.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘når systemene kan forveksles’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘når systema kan forvekslast’.

findings.summary: The conductor-description bullet used Oppgi, gjelder, leder, platetykkelse, and rørveggens tykkelse.
evidence: The previous bullet mixed Bokmål terminology in every main noun and verb.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘Oppgje’, ‘gjeld’, ‘leiar’, ‘platetjukkleik’, and ‘tjukkleiken på røyrveggen’.

findings.summary: The stranded-conductor bullet retained Bokmål forms flertrådede, ledere, må oppgi, and samlet.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘For flertrådede ledere må du oppgi ... samlet diameter’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to consistent Nynorsk: ‘For fleirtrådige leidarar må du oppgje ... samla diameter’.
